The payer: who they are, where they are (which decides their tax), and what they are owed.

A customer can carry money in three distinct forms, and they are not interchangeable. **Promotional credit** is goodwill you granted — it reduces invoices and is never refundable. **Excess payment** is real money they overpaid, held until an invoice needs it. A **wallet** is prepaid balance, which may have been paid for or granted. An invoice draws on them in a fixed order, so the same total settles the same way every time.

Archiving a customer is soft and reversible. `clear_personal_data` is not: it redacts the personal fields in place for erasure requests and detaches every vaulted instrument. The ledger, invoices and payments are left intact — the ledger is append-only and the numbers still have to add up.
